Documentation passages:

[pricing-1] Plans and seats
Brightwell Cloud has three plans, billed per workspace. Starter costs $19 per month and allows up to 3 users. Team costs $49 per month and includes 10 users; each additional user on Team costs $6 per user per month. Business costs $199 per month and includes 25 users, single sign-on (SSO) and the audit log.

[data-3] Data export
CSV and JSON exports are available on every plan. Business plans can also schedule automatic exports to an Amazon S3 bucket.

[data-5] Audit logs
Audit logs are available only on the Business plan and are kept for 1 year.

[sla-1] Uptime commitment
Business plans are covered by a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment and Team plans by a 99.5% monthly uptime commitment. Starter plans have no uptime commitment, are not covered by the service level agreement and are not eligible for service credits after an outage.

Customer question: How many users are included in the Business plan?

data.answer: The Business plan includes 25 users. It costs $199 per month and also comes with single sign-on (SSO) and the audit log.
